content: Who are the licensed drivers in the Reyes household?

name: query_salesforce

content:
All three members of the [Reyes Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmQAAU/view) are marked as licensed drivers:

- [Daniel Reyes](/lightning/r/003aj00002T8RC0AAN/view): spouse or partner
